title: Apidiff — API Contract Check

changes.message: Removed field: email — BREAKING. Existing clients reading user.email will fail.
changes.suggestion: Restore email, or release as /v2/users with a migration note.

changes.message: Type changed: age — BREAKING. Changed from number to string. Clients expecting a number will fail.
changes.suggestion: Keep age as a number, or coerce consistently across all clients before deployment.

changes.message: Added field: phone — SAFE. Backwards compatible; existing clients may ignore it.
changes.suggestion: No action required. This change is safe to deploy.

verdict: ⛔ BREAKING CHANGE — DO NOT DEPLOY v2 until email is restored and age is returned as a number, or release as /v2/users
